markdown:
## RanobeGemini
Browser extension enhancing web novel translations using Google's Gemini AI. Transforms poorly translated content on popular novel sites with one click.
**Tech:** JavaScript, Gemini-AI, Browser-Extension, HTML, CSS
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/RanobeGemini

## Youtube-Keystrokes-Blocker
A powerful userscript that gives you fine-grained control over YouTube keyboard shortcuts. Block distracting hotkeys while keeping the ones you need active.
**Tech:** JavaScript, Userscript, Browser-API
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/Youtube-Keystrokes-Blocker

## ToxicGuard_AI
ToxiGuard AI is a browser extension that detects and censors toxic language in real-time using TensorFlow.js. It offers fine-grained controls, visual feedback, auto-censor, adjustable sensitivity, and respects user privacy.
**Tech:** HTML, JavaScript, TensorFlow.js, Browser-Extension, NLP
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/ToxicGuard_AI

## EquiLens
AI Bias Detection Platform for LLMs via Ollama. Interactive CLI with corpus generation, multi-metric auditing, statistical analysis & visualization. Features enhanced auditors, dynamic concurrency, resume capability & rich progress tracking.
**Tech:** Python, Ollama, Rich-CLI, Statistical-Analysis, uv
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/EquiLens

## Save-Sync
VS Code Extension to save your project at working save points.
**Tech:** TypeScript, VS-Code-API, Node.js
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/Save-Sync

## Eldritchify
Eldritchify is a cosmic horror-themed Zalgo text generator that corrupts and purifies text using Unicode combining characters. Invoke the whispers of Azathoth, channel the chaos of Nyarlathotep, or cleanse your text from the madness with this Lovecraftian-inspired web tool!
**Tech:** HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Unicode
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/Eldritchify

## ViewFlare
Ultra-efficient serverless view counter with admin panel and SVG badges. Optimized for Cloudflare's free tier with headless telemetry tracking.
**Tech:** HTML, JavaScript, Cloudflare-Workers, REST-API, SVG
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/ViewFlare

## the-pensive-index
Library-first fanfiction discovery platform with hierarchical tagging and intelligent prompt generation. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Spec-Driven Development.
**Tech:** TypeScript, Next.js, Cloudflare-D1, Drizzle-ORM, Cloudflare-Pages
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/the-pensive-index

## eVidya
eVidya: Interactive tech learning platform with progress tracking, video lessons, quizzes, and responsive design for self-paced education in programming languages and web development.
**Tech:** JavaScript, HTML, CSS, REST-API
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/eVidya

## cspell-sync
cspell-sync: VS Code extension syncing project spelling dictionaries with global settings for consistent spell checking across workspaces.
**Tech:** TypeScript, VS-Code-API, Node.js, JSON
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/cspell-sync

## Facial-Emotion-Detector
Facial emotion detection using MediaPipe and machine learning. Extract facial landmarks, train models, and classify emotions in real-time from images and videos.
**Tech:** Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, scikit-learn, NumPy
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/Facial-Emotion-Detector

## ActionsCounter
An event counter built out of nothing but GitHub itself. A workflow run on demand updates tallies kept in the repository's own Actions variables, and a static Pages dashboard reads them back. Superseded by ViewFlare.
**Tech:** TypeScript, GitHub-Actions, GitHub-API
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/ActionsCounter

## SignLanguageDetector
Sign Language Detector is a real-time ISL recognition system. It uses OpenCV and MediaPipe for hand tracking, a machine learning classifier for gesture recognition, and a Flask web interface for live inference.
**Tech:** Python, Flask, MediaPipe, OpenCV, scikit-learn, NumPy, JavaScript
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/SignLanguageDetector

## BreachCheck
BreachCheck is a tool designed to help users check if their email addresses or passwords have been involved in known data breaches. It leverages APIs from various breach database aggregators to provide users with information about their potential exposure.
**Tech:** Python, Streamlit, REST-API, HIBP-API
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/BreachCheck

## PulseWard-HMS
Licensed proprietary software developed under a commercial licence. The repository is private, so this entry records the work rather than linking to public source — details available on request.
**Tech:** Proprietary

## HiveXplore
HiveXplore is a beginner-friendly app built on Hive blockchain that introduces newcomers to decentralized social media without technical barriers. Features simplified authentication, intuitive posting tools, and guided experiences as an educational gateway for blockchain beginners.
**Tech:** Python, Flask, SQLite, Hive-Blockchain, JavaScript, REST-API
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/HiveXplore

## dev-prune
Reclaim disk space from idle Git repositories. A Rust CLI that deletes node_modules, .venv, target and vendor only after the project's own package manager proves a lockfile can rebuild them.
**Tech:** Rust, cargo, cli, npm, pip, cross-platform
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/dev-prune

## docs-rag
A strictly grounded RAG pipeline over documents you choose. It answers only from the sources you give it, cites the passages it used, and refuses when those documents do not support an answer - a constraint verified mechanically rather than merely requested in a prompt.
**Tech:** Python, rag, gemini, numpy, pypdf, trafilatura, uv
**GitHub:** https://github.com/FissionLife/docs-rag

## Code-Ledger
Auto-commit every accepted LeetCode, GeeksforGeeks, Codeforces, NeetCode and takeuforward solution to your own GitHub repo - with AI code review, a live analytics dashboard, a knowledge graph, streaks and badges, bulk history import and cross-device sync. No servers, no accounts, no payments.
**Tech:** JavaScript, Preact, manifest-v3, chrome-extension, firefox-addon, github-api, indexeddb
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/Code-Ledger

## LoginLens
Browser extension that answers "which account did I use here?" — it records the provider and MFA method per site, entirely on-device. No passwords, no account, no backend, no telemetry.
**Tech:** TypeScript, Plasmo, Manifest V3, React, IndexedDB
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/LoginLens

## Chronos-Ledger
Multi-dimensional timetable engine, campus-first: geofenced check-in, a real-time WebSocket hub and offline-first PWA behaviour, deployable in one Docker command. Generalizing to any system that needs to query and slice complex schedules.
**Tech:** FastAPI, Next.js 14, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, WebSocket
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/Chronos-Ledger

## CogniGate
Self-hosted, multi-tenant LLM gateway written in Go. One key and an OpenAI-compatible API in front of your providers, with rate limiting and fallback, and provider credentials that never leave your deployment.
**Tech:** Go, PostgreSQL, Docker
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/CogniGate

## Vectra-180
Dual-fisheye dashcam and stereoscopic depth engine for the Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 — two 180° sensors calibrated into a single depth map alongside synchronised IMU telemetry.
**Tech:** Python, OpenCV, Raspberry Pi CM5, NumPy
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/Vectra-180

## portfolio-creator
A guided form that writes the one file a portfolio is configured by. It runs entirely in the browser with no backend and no account, validates every answer against the portfolio's own JSON Schema, and can create the repository and turn on Pages at the end.
**Tech:** React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Ajv, JSON Schema, GitHub API
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/portfolio-creator

## CareReach
An AI-powered telemedicine platform for remote healthcare consultations, built as a Streamlit app. Users chat with Gemini 1.5 Flash about their symptoms, search nearby hospitals by specialist type through the Google Maps Places API, book appointments, and review their health history, with bcrypt-hashed logins stored in SQLite.
**Tech:** Python, Streamlit, Gemini API, Google Maps API, SQLite
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/CareReach

## EchoSight
A contact-center call quality review tool that turns a raw transcript into an annotated coaching report in a single API call. Deterministic, rule-based moment detection keeps every flag auditable, Gemini powers transcript simulation and a live interactive agent chat, and the in-memory store sits behind a small adapter so it can swap to any database without touching business logic. Built for a hackathon and complete as delivered.
**Tech:** Node.js, Express, Gemini API, Server-Sent Events
**GitHub:** https://github.com/Life-Experimentalist/EchoSight
